headline: AB Enzymes anti-staling launch; Planet A cocoa powder replacer; WHO UPF profiling model
summary: Barry Callebaut has launched Flavourcode, a controlled cocoa fermentation platform, putting direct pressure on Belcolade's own fermentation-flavour work.
Cocoa-saving solutions are multiplying, with Planet A Foods' new cocoa powder replacer and RFINE's coffee-ground cocoa extender competing directly with Belcolade's offer.
AB Enzymes launched Veron MaxiFresh, an amylase anti-staling enzyme, while clean-label mould inhibition stays a hot topic; benchmark against Puratos freshness ranges.
Ultra-processed food rules are taking shape, with a WHO profiling model and US labelling estimates showing most cost will be reformulation, which Puratos can support with clean-label solutions.
FDA approved three more natural colour additives as the US moves against synthetic dyes, easing reformulation of glazes, fillings and coloured chocolate.

items.title: New enzyme ingredient extends shelf life in baked foods
items.summary: AB Enzymes launches Veron MaxiFresh, an amylase-based enzyme that extends the freshness and shelf life of baked goods.
items.why: A direct competitor launch in anti-staling enzymes, a core Puratos freshness area; benchmark against Puratos Intens/Soft'r ranges.

items.title: Planet A Foods Launches Cocoa Powder Replacer Amid Rising Cocoa Prices
items.summary: Planet A Foods launches a cocoa powder replacer as cocoa prices stay high.
items.why: Cocoa-free chocolate leader Planet A Foods (ChoViva) moving into cocoa powder replacement competes directly with Belcolade cocoa-saving products; evaluate or partner.

items.title: Choosing clean label mold inhibitors without sacrificing shelf life
items.summary: Article on how bakers choose clean-label, natural mould inhibitors without losing shelf life.
items.why: Clean-label mould inhibition is a core Puratos bakery solution area; use it to position Puratos fermentation-based preservation with US bakers.

items.title: Chocolate industry turns to financial markets to pay for cocoa
items.summary: Report that chocolate makers are turning to financial markets and new financing tools to pay for cocoa amid price volatility.
items.why: Cocoa financing and hedging shifts affect Belcolade's sourcing costs and customer pricing; worth tracking how competitors manage cocoa exposure.

items.title: WHO Proposes Food Profiling Model to Inform Regulation of Ultra-Processed Foods
items.summary: WHO proposes a nutrient-profiling model to guide how countries regulate ultra-processed foods.
items.why: A WHO UPF profiling model could underpin labels, taxes and marketing limits on bread, cakes and chocolate worldwide; track the draft and prepare reformulation support for customers.

items.title: FDA approves, expands 3 natural color additives after RFK Jr.'s plan to remove artificial food dyes
items.source: ABC News - Breaking News, Latest News and Videos
items.summary: FDA approved or expanded three natural colour additives as the administration pushes to remove artificial food dyes.
items.why: More approved natural colours ease the switch away from synthetic dyes in glazes, fillings, decorations and coloured chocolate; update Puratos and Belcolade colour options for US customers.

items.title: White sourdough bread high in protein and fiber with the substitution of cowpea tempeh flour and less yam tuber flour
items.summary: Indonesian study substituting wheat flour in white sourdough bread with cowpea tempeh and lesser yam flours to raise protein and fiber.
items.why: A tempeh-flour sourdough route to high-protein, high-fibre bread is a product idea for Sapore sourdough and protein-enrichment solutions in Asia.

items.title: Revyve debuts yeast protein solution as whey supply challenges persist
items.summary: Revyve launches a yeast-protein ingredient as an alternative to whey amid supply challenges.
items.why: Yeast protein that replaces whey or egg functionality is a partner or supplier option for Puratos egg- and dairy-reduction in cakes and protein bakery.

items.title: French yeast giant leverages Chinese talents, CIIE for growth
items.summary: A French yeast major (likely Lesaffre) is using Chinese talent and the CIIE import expo to grow in China.
items.why: A yeast competitor stepping up in China affects Puratos's bakery ingredient position there; track its fermentation and improver offers.

items.title: Two-Thirds of the $14.2 Billion UPF Label Estimate Is Reformulation. Spend It Where You Grow.
items.summary: Analysis arguing that two-thirds of a $14.2 billion estimated cost of UPF labelling would go to reformulation, and advising firms where to invest.
items.why: If US UPF labelling arrives, most cost falls on reformulation; Puratos can position clean-label improvers, enzymes and sourdough as the reformulation toolkit for bread, cake and chocolate customers.

items.title: Is there a place for better-for-you pizza?
items.summary: Article on whether better-for-you pizza has a place, with protein and fibre as opportunities.
items.why: Protein- and fibre-enriched pizza crusts are a product idea for Puratos protein and fibre bakery solutions with US foodservice customers.
